description.zh: 按住右键画一下：后退、前进、回到顶部、关闭窗口、打开 Win顺 搜索框……每个手势都能改成按键或打开程序。管理员身份运行的窗口里用不了
description.en: Hold the right button and draw: back, forward, to the top, close the window, open WinShun's search… Each gesture can press keys or open a program instead. Not in windows run as administrator

notes.zh: 新插件：按住右键画一下。默认向左后退、向右前进、向上到顶、向下到底，右下关窗口、左下最小化，上下叫出 Win顺 的搜索框；每个手势都能改成别的动作、按键或打开某个东西，还能加最多 6 笔的手势。单按右键菜单照常出来，全屏程序、列出的程序和管理员窗口里不起作用。
notes.en: New plugin: hold the right button and draw. By default left goes back, right forward, up to the top, down to the bottom, down-right closes the window, down-left minimizes and up-down opens WinShun's search box; each can do another action, send keys or open something, and gestures of up to 6 strokes can be added. A plain right click still brings its menu; full-screen programs, listed programs and administrator windows are left alone.
